description: A bearded man in chainmail and a cross-marked surcoat stands with his back to us, right arm raised toward a seated assembly in a stone hall with timber roof trusses and wall torches. The audience is mostly armoured men in mail and plate with red cross tabards, plus commoners in hoods and plain brown and green wool, on wooden benches and steps. Smoke rises near the back wall beside a Gothic doorway. No legible text, no frame, edge-to-edge oil-style painting, medieval setting, nothing violent.
